PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Senior Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience delivering business transformation initiatives across Banking, 
Financial Services, Capital Markets, FinTech, and Digital Platforms. Expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder 
management, business process modeling, API integrations, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and end-to-end 
Agile project delivery. 
Skilled in translating complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions through BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, 
Functional Specifications, Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM), Process Flows, and UAT execution. Proven ability 
to collaborate across business, technology, compliance, and operations to deliver high-impact enterprise solutions. 
Currently leading business analysis for the onboarding of BlackRock Global Mutual Funds at India International Exchange 
(India INX – IFSC), enabling regulated access for Indian investors to global investment opportunities through international 
market infrastructure.
